parole.significato: A member of the dominant ethnic group in Nepal, with a Himalayan diaspora.
parole.testo: From Nepali गोर्खा (gorkhā, “inhabitant of Gorkha”), from गोरखा (gorakhā)/गोर्खा (gorkhā, “Gorkha District”), from Sanskrit गोरक्ष (gorakṣa, “cowherd”) an epithet of the patron deity Gorakhnath, from गो (go, “cow”) + रक्ष् (rakṣ, “protect”).

parole.significato: The inhabitants of the medieval Khas Kingdom.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nepali खस (khas), from Sanskrit खश (khaśa). Doublet of Khasa.

parole.significato: a warrior and ruling class in Nepali society of Khas people
parole.testo: From Nepali क्षेत्री (kṣetrī), from Sanskrit क्षत्रिय (kṣatriya, “protector of gentle people”), from क्षत्र (kṣatra, “rule, dominion, authority”). Cognate with Old Persian 𐎧𐏁𐎠𐎹𐎰𐎡𐎹 (x-š-a-y-θ-i-y /⁠xšāyaθiya⁠/, “emperor”), from which is derived Persian شاه (šâh).
